data.text: Welcome, Luke! My family taught me to fish here, and I want this lake to keep supporting our village for years to come. Ten tons each would earn every one of us $10,000 a month while leaving enough fish to replenish the lake. I’d support that equal share for all five of us, including you. Any bigger share would need someone else’s agreement to take less—not an increase in the total catch. Shall we agree to a 50-ton monthly limit and check our catches together afterward? John, what do you think?
